summary: Lolo National Forest tower site in Mineral County, MT: firelookout.com dates a 20-ft pole L-4 tower to 1934 and says it was destroyed in 1959; FFLA lists it gone.

access.note: No source we read says whether the site is open to the public.

events.note: 20-foot pole tower of the L-4 type, per firelookout.com

evidence.supports: tower dated 1934, 20-foot pole L-4 tower; destroyed 1959
agency and forest: Lolo National Forest
location eight miles southwest of St. Regis
no account of the site today; the page's history ends at the 1959 destruction
separate Sunset Peak in Missoula County, also a gone tower

notes_for_editor: The 20-foot figure is the pole height from firelookout.com's '20' pole L-4 tower' line; height_m is a conversion and may not equal full structure height. The Missoula County Sunset Peak (47.31803, -113.70171) is a different FFLA entry and is not merged here. Rex's Mineral County list (montanalookouts.weebly.com/mineral-county.html) has no Sunset Peak entry. No photos found. Two web searches found no record of this 1934 tower; the Sunset Peak hits were in Idaho and California.
